asked.item: Is there a 100 MB Google Drive cutoff?
Google virus scan warning page instead of the file

verdict.reason: The pages say there is no 100 MB Drive cutoff and give the direct download URL format and the fallback options for the virus-scan warning page.

steps.text: Blotato does not impose a 100 MB Google Drive cutoff.
The file still must fit your Blotato plan's upload limit and the destination platform's media limit.
Google Drive sometimes returns a virus-scan warning page instead of the file for large videos.

Replace the standard share link with https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id={FILE_ID}&export=download&confirm=t, using the ID from your share link, and make sure the file is shared with "Anyone with the link" as Viewer.
If the direct download URL still returns the warning page, use the Presigned Upload flow, frame.io, AWS S3, or Google Cloud Storage.
